text:
Omar: recap from today's sync: we need a short compatibility shim spec + test harness so customers can validate policy-escrow behavior before migration. goal: low-friction, deterministic tests.
Sofia: yes. request: include deterministic attestor simulators (hw_attest_ok, agent_key_ok, agent_key_weak, kms_offline) and a golden CI matrix. tests should assert both decision and evidence_hash shape.
Ben: also call out migration pain: some existing policies assume full signal set. we need a migration mode that emits "signal_missing" warnings instead of DENY for 2 weeks by default. sales can extend per contract.
Lina: good point. propose a mode flag on broker: migration_grace_period_seconds and migration_behavior={warn,deny}. default warn for 14d. runtime should surface a metric redwood.policy.migration.warn_count.
Raj: test harness idea: small dockerized runtime + local-broker that can flip adapter types and signal sets. harness tests: 1) attest->grant->use 2) streaming renewal under simulated 120ms attestation 3) cache invalidation on model rollout -> force re-attest 4) offline-unlock flow for kms_offline.
Omar: add a churn test that exercises 1k tenants requesting grants simultaneously to measure broker QPS and cache effectiveness. capture 95/99/999p latencies.
Sofia: also add a negative test for time-skew: attestor with clock drift should produce evidence_hash mismatch. harness should verify failure path and generate clear log guidance.
Ben: operational knobs we should include in RFC: broker_concurrency_limit, grant_cache_ttl_seconds, hot_lease_heartbeat_ms, jwks_grace_period_seconds, migration_grace_period_seconds. default values and rationale.
Lina: sample default set in RFC draft: broker_concurrency_limit=500, grant_cache_ttl_seconds=300, hot_lease_heartbeat_ms=15000, jwks_grace_period_seconds=600, migration_grace_period_seconds=1209600 (14d).
Raj: small REST example for runtime -> broker that we can include in docs. keep minimal to demonstrate latency-friendly flow.
```
POST /policy/check
{ "policy_id":"pii_block_v1", "signals": {"tenant_id":"acme","model_id":"rwd-large","geo":"eu"}}
-> 200 {"decision":"DEGRADE","evidence_hash":"sha256:...","grant":"eyJhbGci..."}
```
Omar: logging guidance: never log grants or raw attest payloads. log only evidence_hash and release_cid. add a health metric redwood.broker.grant_fail_rate.
Sofia: security review note: ensure the offline-unlock flow requires local operator key protected by OS-level ACL, and unlock commands generate an audit entry signed by local operator key. include sample 'redwood-escrow unlock' CLI output in docs.
Ben: UX: onboarding CLI 'redwood check-compat --mode private --show-missing' to simulate runtime with customer config. output should list missing signals and recommended enforcement mapping. helps sales + SEs.
Lina: runtime SDK changes: add PolicyClient.check(policy_id, context) sync API and check_async for streaming; include local cache that respects grant.exp and supports forced_invalidate().
Raj: metrics to add: grant_latency_ms p50/p95/p99, grant_cache_hit_rate, migration_warn_count, override_grants_issued. telemetry must omit sensitive payloads.
Omar: docs: short quickstart + e2e harness instructions + sample docker-compose for the simulated attestors. include minimal troubleshooting checklist for common failures (clock skew, cert chain, missing signals, jwks mismatch).
Sofia: i'll wire the harness repo scaffold and a small README. Ben pls draft migration messaging for customer comms. Lina pls update SDK API doc. Raj pls add perf tests and baseline numbers. i'll update the RFC with these deliverables and propose a pilot with two existing dedicated customers.
